flags.message: Disposition-taxonomy asymmetry affects exact-label accuracy: the November 13 docket entry explicitly grants only a reformulated question, but outcome.json uses actual_disposition=granted. claude-baseline and codex-baseline use granted-in-part and correctly forecast that scope in prose, yet each receives correct=0 under the required exact-label rule; gemini-baseline uses granted and receives correct=1. Brier scores use actual_granted=1 unchanged. Please review label consistency; no input was edited or score normalized.
